ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: Mid-cycle (day 21) and short-term overbought (StochRSI 100). Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Not a short signal — just don't add here; pullbacks to the 10-day average are normal.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 32 · failed · daily cycle day 21).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Stretched/late — protect gains and don't start new positions; let the next low set up first.
entry.text_zh: 已拉伸／晚期——保护利润，不要新开仓；先等下一个低点构筑成形。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 21 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 21 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 32 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 32 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 周期中段（第 21 天）且短期超买 （StochRSI 100）。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 并非做空信号——只是此处不宜加仓；回调至 10 日均线属于正常现象。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)（投资者周期第 32 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期第 21 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近高点。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
上一周期见顶偏早（趋势走弱的暗示）
